question:
Fill in the blanks:

The Santosh Trophy 2022–23 final was uniquely hosted in _____, where Karnataka won after 54 years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Riyadh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Santosh Trophy 2022-23** final was held in **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**, marking a historic and unique milestone in the history of Indian football. This was the first time the tournament was conducted outside India.
 
• **Karnataka’s victory** in the Santosh Trophy 2022-23 was significant as they won the title after a gap of **54 years**. Their last victory was in the year **1968-69**.
 
• The final match was held at the **King Fahd International Stadium**, a renowned stadium in Riyadh that typically hosts international football matches and other sporting events.
 
• The decision to host the Santosh Trophy final in Riyadh was a part of efforts by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** to promote Indian football globally and build connections with the Indian diaspora in the Middle East.
 
• The initiative was also a step towards enhancing **India’s football presence internationally** and creating a bridge between Indian football and football fans worldwide, especially in the Gulf region. *Hence, the statement about Riyadh being the location is correct.*
 
• Riyadh provided a unique platform for players to perform on an international stage, with the event attracting attention from both Indian and international audiences.
 
• *Hence, the correct answer is Riyadh.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Santosh Trophy:**

 
 
• The **Santosh Trophy** is an annual football tournament in India, organized by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**. It primarily features teams representing various Indian states and government institutions.
 
• The tournament was started in **1941** and named after Maharaja **Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary** of Santosh (a region in Bengal). It is one of the oldest and most prestigious football tournaments in India.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka’s Achievement:**
 
 
• Karnataka’s win in the 2022-23 season is a **historic milestone** for the state, as they ended their 54-year title drought. Previously, they had won the tournament under the name of Mysore.
 
• The team showcased remarkable performance throughout the tournament, with standout players contributing to the victory.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Hosting in Riyadh:**
 
 
• Hosting the final in Riyadh was a strategic move to engage with the **Indian diaspora**, which has a significant presence in the Gulf region. It also aimed to expand the global footprint of Indian football.
 
• Riyadh’s **King Fahd International Stadium** is a world-class venue, and its selection underscored the ambition to raise the profile of the Santosh Trophy as a prominent football event.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of the Santosh Trophy 2022-23:**

 
 
• **Venue:** The final was held at the **King Fahd International Stadium** in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This marked the first time the tournament was hosted outside India.
 
• **Winner:** Karnataka emerged victorious, defeating Meghalaya in the final match.
 
• **Objective:** The decision to host the final abroad was aimed at showcasing Indian football on a global stage and strengthening ties with the Indian community in the Gulf region.
 
 
 
• **Global Outreach of Indian Football:**
 
 
• The AIFF’s initiative to host the Santosh Trophy final in Riyadh reflects efforts to **globalize Indian football** and attract international attention to the sport in India.
 
• Such events also provide Indian players with exposure to international standards and facilities, enhancing their experience and performance.
